sentences.text:
Learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits  that the land in question is raiyati land of the petitioner bearing  Khesra No.287, Khata no.146 measuring area 1 katha 5 dhur  situated in Mauza Bagh Taz khan alias Pokhara, Mohalla-  Pokhara, Sapatu situated in survey ward no.5 presently,
 appertaining to municipal ward no.17 within the area of Hajipur  Nagar Parishad, Hajipur (Vaishali).

Senior counsel submits that  the Hajipur Municipality has grabbed the part of raiyati land of  the petitioner appertaining to C.S. Plot No.601 and 598  measuring 1 katha 5 dhur and included it in newly created  Khesra no.287 showing it as municipal road and got created  khatiyan in the name of Hajipur Municipality.

After coming to  know, the petitioner's mother had filed a Title Suit No.216/1986  which was decreed in her favour and judgment and decree dated  19.12.1990 and 07.01.1991 were passed and prepared holding that Hajipur Municipality has got no concern with the said land and it belongs to the petitioner's mother.

Senior counsel further Patna High Court CWJC No.1750 of 2019 dt.08-05-2025 submits that being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the said judgment and decree, the Municipality has preferred Title Appeal no.09/1991 before the District Judge, Vaishali which was dismissed vide order dated 08.01.2001.

Senior counsel submits that a partition suit was filed by the petitioner, however the said partition suit decreed by compromise Hari Narayan Bhagat vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8825260/
2 decree dated 19.08.2016 in Partition Suit No.418/2016 and title of the land in question came in the name of the petitioner.

entities.text: Hari Narayan Bhagat vs The State Of Bihar And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Senior counsel submits since the municipality has taken land of the petitioner without any provisions of Land Acquisition Act and without making any compensation,
therefore, he seeks direction from this Court that payment of compensation be made to the petitioner.
4. Learned counsel for the State submits that it is a dispute between the petitioner and Hajipur Nagar Parishad.

5. Learned counsel appearing for Hajipur Nagar Parishad submits that in the light of the direction made by this Hon'ble Court vide order dated 24.04.2025, a supplementary counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of Respondent nos.6 & 7 with a clear cut stand that Hajipur Nagar Parishad does not lay any claim on the right title or interest upon the petitioner's land.

It has been submitted that Hajipur Nagar Parishad understands Patna High Court CWJC No.1750 of 2019 dt.08-05-2025 that the decree dated 07.01.1991 passed in favour of the petitioner's family in Title Suit No.216/1986 has attained finality.

It has been mentioned further that the officials of Hajipur Nagar Parishad has visited the subjected land on 18.04.2024 and during the course of their visit, it become evident that the subject land of the petitioner is like a kachha raasta and no pucca road has been constructed upon it.
In this regard, they have attached the photocopy also vide Annexure- R6/1.

It has been reiterated that the Hajipur Nagar Parishad that the nagar parishad has not used the petitioner's raiyati land in any mode or manner and that the petitioner is free to use the same as he deems fit.

6. In the light of the submissions made that Hajipur Municipality has taken the stand that after acquiring the finality about the title of the land, the petitioner is free to use his land in his own way and this land is not for the use of Hajipur Nagar Parishad, this writ petition become infructuous.

7. As such, the present writ petition stands disposed off granting liberty to the petitioner to use his land as per his own choice in the light of the decree passed in the title suit which acquires finality now and about which the defendant of title suit and respondent of present writ petition has come with Patna High Court CWJC No.1750 of 2019 dt.08-05-2025 specific stand that petitioner is free to use his land as per the judgment and decree.

(Dr. Anshuman, J) Divyansh/-
